title: My Hero Craft
description: This project adds quirks, that you can get from different items.
body:
This mod adds: 


All-Might's hair - gives you quirk (infinite effect) of All-Might (when you are shifting - you are getting stronger)


Hardering Injection - gives you quirk of Hardering (when shifting, you have resistance)


ZeroGravity Injection - gives you quirk of ZeroGravity (when shifting, you can fly with levitation effect)


Invisibility Injection - gives you quirk of Invisibility (if you have glove in your off hand, you are turning visible back)


Glove - if in both hands and you have One For All quirk, makes you stronger. When in off-hand when you have invisibility quirk, turns you visible


Punchable stone - just fun thing! you can also ride it

Quirk remover - removes your quirk

Punch stick - has no damage and increased attack knockback
